answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow blocks bulk fakes. Each applicant locks 50 credits and builds a fingerprint over 20 epochs. A gale of copied forms fails: real work leaves a different mark on each mesa, not one gust repeated. Release needs a later match; a falcon cannot be claimed by many hunters. Faking 100 identities costs 5,000 credits and 2,000 epoch-slots, and copying slashes the escrow. An honest user pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
